pages.title: Vero Tapir
pages.text: The Vero tapir ($(o)Tapirus veroensis$()) is an extinct tapir that lived in southeastern North America during the Pleistocene, disappearing at its end.$(br2)It was named after Vero Beach in Florida, where its fossils were first described.$(br2)Similar in size and build to living tapirs, it inhabited forests and wetlands, browsing on leaves and other vegetation.
